 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$

 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

    raise exception using errcode='42501', message='Administrator access required.';

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'review_only', true,

    'counts', jsonb_build_object(
      'pending_coffees', (select count(*) from public.coffee_submissions where status='pending'),
      'conflicts', (select count(*) from public.coffee_submissions where status='conflict'),

      'pending_verified_accounts', (select count(*) from private.beta_members m join auth.users u on u.id=m.owner_id where m.admitted_at is null and m.signup_review_state='pending' and u.email_confirmed_at is not null),
      'unfinished_account_deletions', (select count(*) from private.dic_admin_account_delete_operations where phase<>'completed'),
      'shot_records', (select count(*) from public.shots where hidden_at is null)
    ),
    'queue_total', (select count(*) from public.coffee_submissions where status in ('pending','conflict')),
    'queue', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(item.data order by item.created_at, item.id)
      from (
        select id, created_at,
          jsonb_build_object(
            'id', id,
            'created_at', created_at,
            'status', status,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dic_admin_review_candidates(p_submission_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE s public.coffee_submissions;
BEGIN
 PERFORM private.require_member();
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT private.is_admin() THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='42501',message='Administrator required.';
 END IF;
 SELECT * INTO s FROM public.coffee_submissions
  WHERE id=p_submission_id AND status IN ('pending','conflict');
 IF NOT FOUND THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING errcode='22023',message='Pending submission unavailable.';
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('candidates',coalesce((
  SELECT jsonb_agg(candidate ORDER BY similarity_score DESC,coffee_name,coffee_id)
  FROM (
   SELECT c.id AS coffee_id,c.name AS coffee_name,
    CASE WHEN private.dic_coffee_key(c.name)=private.dic_coffee_key(s.proposed_data->>'name')
         THEN 1::numeric ELSE extensions.similarity(private.dic_coffee_key(c.name),
             private.dic_coffee_key(s.proposed_data->>'name'))::numeric END AS similarity_score,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id',c.id,'name',c.name,'roaster',c.roaster,'origin',c.origin,
      'process',c.process,'release_label',c.release_label,'producer',c.producer,
      'variety',c.variety,'roast_level',c.roast_level,'elevation_m',c.elevation_m,
      'tasting_notes',c.tasting_notes,'summary',c.summary,
      'espressoNotes',c.espresso_notes,'source_url',
         (SELECT source_url FROM public.coffee_sources cs
          WHERE cs.coffee_id=c.id AND cs.source_url IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cs.checked_at DESC LIMIT 1),
      'match_reason',CASE WHEN private.dic_coffee_key(c.name)=private.dic_coffee_key(s.proposed_data->>'name')
         THEN 'Same roaster and coffee name' ELSE 'Same roaster and similar coffee name' END
    ) AS candidate
   FROM public.coffees c
   WHERE c.verification_state='verified' AND c.merged_into_id IS NULL
    AND private.dic_canonical_roaster_key(c.roaster)=private.dic_canonical_roaster_key(s.proposed_data->>'roaster')
    AND (private.dic_coffee_key(c.name)=private.dic_coffee_key(s.proposed_data->>'name')
     OR extensions.similarity(private.dic_coffee_key(c.name),private.dic_coffee_key(s.proposed_data->>'name'))>=0.63)
   ORDER BY similarity_score DESC,c.name,c.id LIMIT 10
  ) candidates
 ),'[]'::jsonb));
END $function$
complete_functions.verdict: Authenticated internal Admin-only pending candidate review; normalized roaster and name similarity, capped 10. Candidate provenance URL selected by checked_at, no automatic merge.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dic_member_approval_claim(p_channel text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare batches jsonb;
begin
 if p_channel not in ('email','push') or p_channel is null or
    p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 20 then
  raise exception using errcode='22023',message='Invalid delivery channel/limit';
 end if;
 with chosen as (
  select d.event_id,d.channel
  from private.dic_member_approval_deliveries d
  join private.beta_members m on m.owner_id=d.member_id
  join auth.users u on u.id=d.member_id
  where d.channel=p_channel and m.signup_review_state='approved'
   and m.enabled and m.admitted_at is not null
   and u.email_confirmed_at is not null
   and ((d.state='pending' and d.next_attempt_at<=now())
    or (d.state='sending' and d.lease_until < now()))
  order by d.event_id limit p_limit for update of d skip locked
 ), claimed as (
  update private.dic_member_approval_deliveries d
  set state='sending',attempt_count=d.attempt_count+1,
      claim_token=gen_random_uuid(),lease_until=now()+interval '2 minutes'
  from chosen c where d.event_id=c.event_id and d.channel=c.channel
  returning d.event_id,d.member_id,d.claim_token
 )
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'eventId',c.event_id,'claimToken',c.claim_token,
   'email',case when p_channel='email' then left(u.email,254) else null end,
   'endpoints',case when p_channel='push' then (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('hash',s.endpoint_hash,'endpoint',s.endpoint)),'[]'::jsonb)
    from public.dic_member_approval_push_subscriptions s
    where s.owner_id=c.member_id and s.expires_at>now()
      and s.last_sent_event_id<c.event_id
   ) else '[]'::jsonb end
  ) order by c.event_id),'[]'::jsonb) into batches
 from claimed c join auth.users u on u.id=c.member_id;
 return batches;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dic_member_approval_finish(p_event_id bigint, p_channel text, p_claim_token uuid, p_outcome text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if p_channel not in ('email','push') or p_outcome not in ('sent','skipped','retry')
   or p_claim_token is null or p_event_id is null then
  raise exception using errcode='22023',message='Invalid delivery receipt';
 end if;
 update private.dic_member_approval_deliveries d
 set state=case when p_outcome='retry' then 'pending' else p_outcome end,
     claim_token=null,lease_until=null,
     completed_at=case when p_outcome='retry' then null else now() end,
     next_attempt_at=case when p_outcome='retry' then
       now()+least(60,power(2,least(d.attempt_count,5))::integer)*interval '1 minute'
       else d.next_attempt_at end
 where d.event_id=p_event_id and d.channel=p_channel and
   d.state='sending' and d.claim_token=p_claim_token;
 return found;
end $function$
